params.name: buildId
params.description: Build id (aka head SHA) of the latest build with your changes. This is the same id passed to the Fastlane upload.

params.name: baseBuildId
params.description: Build id (aka base SHA) to compare your build with. This is the same id passed to the Fastlane upload.
